info.title: GoOutside API Documentation
info.description: API Schema specifications for GoOutside Web & Mobile services; expanded proposed API contract based on current ERD. Operations marked x-implementation-status: proposed require backend implementation.

post.description: Creates a new Supabase Auth account and corresponding GoOutside user record.

400.description: Invalid account information or account could not be created

get.description: Returns events. Optional parameters can filter the results.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Return events starting on or after this date

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Return events ending on or before this date

parameters.name: hostID
parameters.description: User ID of the event host

patch.description: Only the owner or an authorized administrator may update this profile.

get.summary: Get package history for a user
get.description: Restricted to the owner or authorized administrators; active package can be identified from active and dates.

post.description: creatorID should be taken from authenticated identity.

get.summary: List conversations accessible to current user
get.description: Conversation participant authorization must be implemented; current ERD does not show a participant table.

post.description: userID must be taken from authenticated identity, not request body.
